g.title: j567000639
g.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !

g.title: j3619684352->j567000639

g.title: j2515421598
g.text: I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !

g.title: j3619684352->j2515421598
g.text: false

g.title: j3291069167
g.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !

g.title: j3979133402->j3291069167
g.text: true

g.title: j3770395357
g.text: The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !

g.title: j3979133402->j3770395357
g.text: false

g.title: j299353507
g.text: Did you enjoy talking to him?

g.title: j4168905161
g.text: How did your conversation with him go?

g.title: j4056090087
g.text: Poor Otak... How did that go?

g.title: j3150825021
g.text: I'm glad you finally met. Otak can be a little hard to explain.

g.title: j2812741725
g.text: You met Otak? Oh boy... How did that go?

g.title: j2058614867
g.text: I did. Though perhaps I wanted to weep for it. For he introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.

g.title: j2269472257
g.text: He... introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.

g.title: j3081124701
g.text: I found him nothing but sweet and charming ! But buried beneath a layer of humor, I felt great heartbreak.

g.title: j1166899571
g.text: Yes, I would think so. A child's scrawl written on the back of an automaton. I found him nothing but sweet and charming !

g.title: j416096382
g.text: Why do you sound less than pleased that I met him ?

g.title: j3692347425
g.text: Greeting me in the same unflinching, cheerful way he had the previous times. But he knew me as a Sœur de Sol !

g.title: j471725186
g.text: Will you tell me the story of poor Monsieur Otak ?

g.title: j3497304762
g.text: But buried beneath the humor, there is great heartbreak.

g.title: j3764461772
g.text: He can get on my nerves sometimes, is all.

g.title: j1251942561
g.text: I didn't mean to. He can just be a little... off putting for some people.

g.title: j2172830320
g.text: I'm sorry. He can get on people's nerves sometimes. It's not his fault.

g.title: j3245955995
g.text: Indeed, he knew much of the Luminaries ! We talked at length of the "Ancient Religions" as he dubbed them, in the "days before the Orokin Empire."

g.title: j2344459805
g.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.

g.title: j183488277
g.text: ฉันหวังว่าคุณจะมีเมตตาต่อผู้อ่อนแอกว่านี้นะ Mais par la grâce de Sol เราคงเป็นแบบนั้นเช่นกัน

g.title: j2458912820
g.text: และฉันหวังว่าพวกเขาจะแสดงความเมตตาและความอดทนต่อเขา Mais par la grâce de Sol เราคงเป็นแบบนั้นเช่นกัน

g.title: j4027407019
g.text: Though he said much of that knowledge was lost now, deep in the archives, and very much forbidden. He swore me to secrecy.

g.title: j1535887036
g.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.

g.title: j2319528050
g.text: Such a fate could wait for any of us. Even you.

g.title: j2746595683
g.text: He told me that he was deeply concerned that Executor Ballas - whoever he may be - might discover my sect of heretics and have me executed.

g.title: j3762440277
g.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful warframes and weapons we make.

g.title: j3190320430
g.text: You're right, I'm sorry. I didn't mean that.

g.title: j3819554275
g.text: I just don't have the time to spend on him, I'm sorry.

g.title: j1349458355
g.text: Ballas is dead... keep going.

g.title: j261421504
g.text: That... won't happen. Keep talking.

g.title: j3205786289
g.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.

g.title: j837231574
g.text: Then I am sorry for wasting more of it.

g.title: j1046433486
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3686466455
g.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.

g.title: j3007723528
g.text: Boolean MarieOtakComplete is now true.

g.title: j4074666668
g.text: I suspected... Well, he asked me where I was from, and when I told him, he laughed and said "no, that's impossible! And I should know, I'm -"

g.title: j3887599870
g.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.

g.title: j3432167038
g.text: And then he... introduced himself to me again. And asked me if I was coming from the plains with mineral samples...

g.title: j2105349457
g.text: Pauvre petit...

g.title: j1536610458
g.text: Yeah... that's Otak.

g.title: j838527418
g.text: Oh, Marie. I'm so sorry...

g.title: j253530729
g.text: Boolean MarieOtak1 is now true.

g.title: j2352381463
g.text: It shatters me into a million pieces to think there is nothing to be done for him.

g.title: j457335464
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1963851720
g.text: Oh, Luminaries - what manner of hell have you made for him, to keep his soul trapped within that cage of science and flickering lights?

g.title: j457335464->j1963851720
g.text: MarieCephalonSoul

g.title: j747825392
g.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that you are right and nothing remains inside that shell but... but science and flickering lights.

g.title: j457335464->j747825392
g.text: MarieCephalonNoSoul

g.title: j1192373579
g.text: I know you are not sure if the Cephalons contain souls - but I can only pray to the Luminaries that... that poor Otak does not suffer.

g.title: j457335464->j1192373579
g.text: MarieCephalonUnsure

g.title: j4005254291
g.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that all that remains inside that shell is nothing but... but science and flickering lights.

g.title: j457335464->j4005254291
g.text: false

g.title: j826016461
g.text: Why leave him there, broken and waiting until he is allowed to die to be given peace? I can only pray... that if there is some kind of presence there -

g.title: j2880449530
g.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.

g.title: j742684529
g.text: That no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.

g.title: j3044740562
g.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.

g.title: j1794756017
g.text: It is because he remains by choice as some kind of lonely vigil...

g.title: j24101861
g.text: Because if you are wrong, and a soul remains within that cage against its will ?

g.title: j1850078665
g.text: Or if there is some kind of presence there, it is because he remains by choice as some manner of lonely vigil.

g.title: j4181414740
g.text: To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?

g.title: j1144645185
g.text: It is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?

g.title: j1111168100
g.text: And then where would I be ?

g.title: j698725705
g.text: Forgive me, I am... I am melancholy today.

g.title: j3251038745
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2829064561
g.text: It's okay. You have every right to be.

g.text: Sometimes the gods are cruel, Marie. That's just life.

g.title: j2935772658
g.text: Merci. Well, I no longer wish to be. I am going to go do something more cheerful ! I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.

g.title: j4158541259
g.text: Ha ! Merci. That is sure to stop these foolish tears of mine. You do know how to cheer silly little Marie, non ?

g.title: j1817394999
g.text: Oui. You are quite right. They are. The world is full of no end of stories like that of Monsieur Otak, and many far worse than his. I should not weep over one.

g.title: j2486340526
g.text: Check boolean MarieDating

g.title: j409448838
g.text: It's the very least I can do for you.

g.title: j1975411380
g.text: You're not being silly at all. I feel the same way.

g.title: j1796043549
g.text: Yet here I sit, doing just that. Thank you for reminding me of my foolishness. Fie! Silly little Marie. Well... I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.

g.title: j4168335523
g.text: À la revoyure, my wolf.

g.text: À la revoyure !

g.text: Merci, merci, merci, my wolf. Let us go, then, and make mischief.
